info.title: Precisely Universal API
info.description: Geocode addresses, resolve PreciselyIDs, enrich locations, and retrieve geographic datasets like time zones, schools, speed limits, and intersections.

get.description: Retrieves geocoding candidates from Precisely for an address.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: mainAddress
parameters.description: Single-line input address, or the street-address portion when structured fields are used.

schema.description: Single-line input address, or the street-address portion when structured fields are used.

parameters.name: placeName
parameters.description: Building, place, point of interest, company, or firm name associated with the address.

schema.description: Building, place, point of interest, company, or firm name associated with the address.

parameters.name: lastLine
parameters.description: The last line of the address.

schema.description: The last line of the address.

parameters.name: areaName1
parameters.description: Largest geographic area, typically a state or province.

schema.description: Largest geographic area, typically a state or province.

parameters.name: areaName3
parameters.description: City or town name.

schema.description: City or town name.

parameters.name: postalCode
parameters.description: Postal code in the appropriate format for the selected country.

schema.description: Postal code in the appropriate format for the selected country.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO country code or country name.

schema.description: ISO country code or country name.

parameters.name: matchMode
parameters.description: Controls how strictly the address is matched.

schema.description: Controls how strictly the address is matched.

parameters.name: maxCands
parameters.description: Maximum number of candidates to return.

schema.description: Maximum number of candidates to return.

parameters.name: removeAccentMarks
parameters.description: Suppress accents and diacritical marks in the output.

schema.description: Suppress accents and diacritical marks in the output.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

addressLastLine.description: City, county, region, and country line.

areaName1.description: Top-level administrative area, typically state or province.

areaName2.description: Secondary administrative area, typically county or district.

precisionCode.description: Precisely precision code for the match.

precisionLevel.description: Matched precision level returned for the candidate.

ranges.description: Range metadata returned for the candidate.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves nearby schools from Precisely by address.

parameters.name: edLevel

schema.description: Provider education level code filter.

parameters.name: schoolSubType
parameters.description: Provider school subtype code filter.

schema.description: Provider school subtype code filter.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Provider gender code filter.

schema.description: Provider gender code filter.

parameters.name: assignedSchoolsOnly
parameters.description: Return only schools assigned to the address.

schema.description: Return only schools assigned to the address.

parameters.name: districtSchoolsOnly
parameters.description: Return only schools in the serving district.

schema.description: Return only schools in the serving district.

parameters.name: searchRadius
parameters.description: Radius around the address to search.

schema.description: Radius around the address to search.

parameters.name: searchRadiusUnit
parameters.description: Unit for the search radius.

schema.description: Unit for the search radius.

parameters.name: travelTime
parameters.description: Travel time threshold around the address.

schema.description: Travel time threshold around the address.

parameters.name: travelTimeUnit
parameters.description: Unit for the travel time.

schema.description: Unit for the travel time.

parameters.name: travelMode
parameters.description: Travel mode used for school proximity calculations.

parameters.name: travelDistance
parameters.description: Travel distance threshold around the address.

parameters.name: travelDistanceUnit
parameters.description: Unit for the travel distance.

schema.description: Unit for the travel distance.

parameters.name: maxCandidates
parameters.description: Maximum number of schools to return.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

mainAddressLine.description: Primary address line for the school.

unit.description: Unit used for the distance from the queried address.

highestGrade.description: Highest grade served by the school.

get.description: Retrieves the nearest intersection from Precisely by location.

get.description: Retrieves the nearest speed limit from Precisely by location.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Two to five semicolon-separated longitude,latitude coordinate pairs.

schema.description: Two to five semicolon-separated longitude,latitude coordinate pairs.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

amPeakAvgSpeed.description: Average observed speed during the morning peak period.

maxSpeed.description: Posted maximum speed limit for the matched road segment.

nightAvgSpeed.description: Average observed speed during night hours.

offPeakAvgSpeed.description: Average observed speed during off-peak periods.

pmPeakAvgSpeed.description: Average observed speed during the evening peak period.

id.description: Provider identifier for the matched road segment.

isToll.description: Whether the matched road segment is a toll road.

lengthInMeters.description: Length of the matched road segment in meters.

roadClass.description: Road-class label for the matched segment.

surfaceType.description: Surface type for the matched road segment.

trafficFlow.description: Traffic-flow direction reported for the matched segment.

speedUnit.description: Unit used for the reported speed limit.

speedVerification.description: Provider verification status for the speed limit.

weekAvgSpeed.description: Average observed speed across the week.
